    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height = len(out)
    width = len(out[0]) if height else 0
    full_rows = {r for r, row in enumerate(out) if all(value == 8 for value in row)}
    full_cols = {c for c in range(width) if all(out[r][c] == 8 for r in range(height))}
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            if out[r][c] == 8 and (r in full_rows or c in full_cols):
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out

    full_cols = {c for c in range(width) if all(out[r][c] == 8 for r in range(height))}
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            if out[r][c] == 8 and (r in full_rows or c in full_cols):
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
